PRESIDENT RUTO ASSENTS TO FOUR BILLS AT STATE HOUSE

September 8, 2026

President William Ruto on Tuesday signed into law four Bills at State House, Nairobi.

The President assented to the Kenya National Council for Population and Development Bill, 2026, the Public Health (Amendment) Bill, 2026, the Cooperatives (Amendment) Bill, 2026, and the Climate Change (Amendment) Bill, 2026.

The four new laws are aimed at improving public health outcomes, strengthening devolved cooperative governance, and accelerating Kenya's climate resilience agenda.

The President noted that the Kenya National Council for Population and Development Act, 2026, establishes a statutory body to coordinate population and development policy across the national and county governments.

The Public Health (Amendment) Act, 2026, modernises Kenya's public health framework to address emerging health threats and align with international health regulations.

The Cooperatives (Amendment) Act, 2026, strengthens the governance of savings and credit cooperative societies and protects members' deposits.

The Climate Change (Amendment) Act, 2026, reinforces Kenya's commitments under the Paris Agreement and establishes a carbon market regulatory framework.
